text:
I visited the clinic for scaling, cleaning, & polish due to some staining on my lower teeth and mild tartar buildup.

The dentist did an excellent job.
(Treatment did not include airflow or fluoride treatment.)

The cost was 1,200 THB, which is on the higher side for Chiang Mai.

The clinic’s website currently lists dental cleaning & polishing at 600–1,000 THB, but the in-clinic price list shows slightly higher pricing. This makes the website pricing outdated and somewhat misleading.

Overall, the dental work itself was excellent, but the clinic should update its online pricing so patients have accurate expectations before visiting.

text: Helpful receptionist who managed to see me despite her busy schedule, dentist was professional and very thorough. Impeccable teeth cleaning 👍 I recommend. …

I had some pain due to my wisdom teeth appearing during a trip in Thailand. I send then an email late in the evening and got an very quick answer and an appointement the next day for examination. All the staff was lovely and spoke good english. The dentist checked and gave me recommendations. Examination was 100 baths. I highly recommend !

Best clinic. Doctor J did very good job to fix the  cavity.
Helpful team and best and clean place.

We were two people for a cleaning. Very good and professional service. Dentist speaks perfect English and is very skilled and knowledgeable.
Would definitely recommend 👌 …
Went to Payon for a consultation and cleaning. Very happy with both.

After to be honest, years of dentist neglect, I had a situation that really required attention- but I also had a lot of shame because of the state of my teeth.

Payon Dental Clinic took care effective Immediately, clearing tons of plaque skilfully and mindfully to how I was feeling, they checked to make sure that I was both comfortable and pain-free, which made what was scary feel safe.

To top it off, the rates were affordable and I now feel more comfortable smiling. Definitely highly recommend, Thank you Payon Dental Clinic!

I called the clinic for a same day appointment. The dentist was very professional with a nice sense of humour.
The clinic is super clean.
Not one for making reviews but service was exceptionally good. Best teeth cleaning I've had or likely the ever have again
The staff is very good and professional. Highly recommended. They extracted a cavity and gave me a dental cleaning. They were very careful during the process.

I had an excellent experience at Payon Dental Clinic! I came in with a broken filling, and the dentist was able to fix it quickly and efficiently. The staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel very comfortable. The dentist did a fantastic job. Highly recommend this clinic.
I just walked in and they saw me the same day, just an hour after signing in. Dr. did a great job deep cleaning my teeth and kept me informed throughout the process. Thanks again.

I had root canal and broken tooth extraction about 6 years ago and no problems since.The temporary filling is still perfect so obviously very high quality, more like a permanent filling. Dr Jay is very nice, gentle and professional.I highly recommend him and he displays his prices, very transparent and reasonable. Thank you Dr Jay.

Excellent! Cannot be better. The dentist are not only good but also VERY PROFESSIONALS,caring and customer oriented. I went for a root canal and they did better by far from what I expected. Nice people and very good dentists. Go,  do not hesitate.100% recommended

The cleaning of the teeth was ok but not very long and intensive but rather quick and easy. The tooth pockets were not cleaned at all and the polishing was more of a short stroking.

I rather had the feeling that care was taken not to do anything wrong instead of doing it right

I walked in yesterday to ask about a cleaning. I was seen early morning today. It’s a beautiful practice: clean, bright, spacious. It was just the dentist (Jay) and assisant, who was also receptionist, both of whom were very friendly. I’m happy with the service and happy to walk out again with clean teeth. The dentist was very gentle, maybe too gentle especially when it came to the polishing. But it’s possible that I’m just used to less gentle treatment back home. Thank you Jay for seeing me at such short notice 😊

The dentist was very kind and gentle with his scaling.
He was very thorough. The clinic has parking and is near Chiang Mai Gate. I was very impressed with the service.
Very professional, well, staffed, and excellent services. I had a crown come loose and walked in off the street. They took great care of me. Dr. Jay really knows what he’s doing.

The clinic is clean and has parking inside.
The dentist is kind and gives excellent advice on dental care for children. My 10-year-old son and 8-year-old daughter come here regularly for dental treatment.
The clinic is very clean, the dentist is skilled and provides appropriate advice, the prices are reasonable, and there's a coffee shop available.
Provides very good advice on dentistry.

I used to be terrified of dental work, but now I'm not scared at all. They do everything here: teeth cleaning, fillings, whitening, veneers – a one-stop shop. The dentist is very steady. After my dental work is done, I even go for coffee at the shop next door. So relaxing!

This is a dental clinic that understands the elderly very well. My 80-year-old father, who has been stubborn and refused to see a dentist for over a decade, went to get his teeth treated here. The dentist has a strong sense of humor, thoroughly examining his teeth, and developing a treatment plan with the patient and family. This allows the family to understand the oral health issues of the elderly and help them better care for my father.

My father, an 80-year-old dentist, is a dentist who fully understands the behavior of the elderly and has not seen a dentist for almost 10 years. The dentist is not only skilled but also has a positive attitude and strong mental skills. The dentist communicated well and collaborated with the patient and family to create a treatment solution, which helped enhance the family members' understanding of how to care for the elderly in daily oral care at home.
The doctor and staff at the clinic provided excellent service. They called to confirm appointments every time, and the doctor explained everything in detail and gave very good advice.

I previously had dental checkups and treatment at a hospital, but wasn't impressed. However, since moving here, I've been very impressed. The dentist is very gentle and friendly. Whether it's scaling, wisdom tooth extraction, fillings, or even teeth whitening, I get it done here. The service is excellent!
The staff is nice, the place is clean and their treatment is wonderful, I always go there every time I visit chiangmai

The clinic is conveniently located in the heart of downtown Chiang Mai. It's a fantastic place to go to get your teeth cleaned. The dentist is very hygienic and skillful when it comes to examining and suggesting answers. The staff is extremely helpful and informative. Amazing experience, every visit is like seeing good old friends.
